to consider (someone or something) as belonging to a particular group 将（某人或某物）视为属于某一特定群体 As a singer, she is hard to classify. = It is hard to classify her as a singer [=to decide what type of singer she is] 作为一名歌手，她很难被归类。 The movie had some funny parts, but I wouldn't classify it as a comedy. 这部电影有一些有趣的片段，但我不会把它归类为喜剧。 The vehicle is classified as a truck. 该车辆被归类为卡车。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

该研究有助于建立新理论。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k 7621e37b-418e-45fa-8955-91fe53cfec59 4465d7f6-3e64-47d8-af55-a3dbd06ededb curiosity noun ˌkjɚriˈɑːsəti https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/curios02.wav noncount [The expression curiosity killed the cat is used to warn people that too much curiosity can be dangerous.]
the desire to learn or know more about something or someone 这个表达用来警告人们，过度的好奇心可能是危险的。对某事或某人的学习或了解更多的渴望 Her natural curiosity led her to ask more questions. 她天生的好奇心促使她提出了更多问题。 The arrival of a construction crew at their house attracted/sparked/aroused the curiosity of their neighbors. 一支施工队的到来引起了他们邻居的好奇心。 The movie failed to satisfy her curiosity about the assassination. 这部电影未能满足她对刺杀事件的好奇心。 intellectual curiosity
He went into the store out of curiosity. [=because he was curious to see what was in the store] 求知欲
他出于好奇走进了商店。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k ee643055-0d0a-45c1-b0f7-990d76b7fafb 4465d7f6-3e64-47d8-af55-a3dbd06ededb curiosity noun ˌkjɚriˈɑːsəti https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/c/curios02.wav count something that is interesting because it is unusual 有趣的东西，因为它不同寻常 Tobacco was once a curiosity in Europe. 烟草曾经在欧洲是一种新奇事物。 The antique shop was full of curiosities. 那家古董店里满是稀奇古怪的物品。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

[=he didn't go to the meeting] 他没去参加会议。 I skipped breakfast, and now I'm really hungry. 我没吃早餐，现在真的很饿。 (chiefly US) They got in trouble for skipping school/class. （主要用于美国）他们因为逃学/逃课而惹上了麻烦。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k 2dca90e4-0a08-459f-8e2f-bba49399c6e5 b214067d-6f81-4500-a50b-bd8c1b3bb2fc skip verb ˈskɪp https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/s/skip0001.wav [often + over]
to not discuss, read, do, or deal with (something) and go instead to the next thing to pass over or leave out (something) 指不讨论、不阅读、不做或不处理（某事），而是转而进行下一件事，跳过或遗漏（某事）。 I skipped the boring parts of the book. 我跳过了这本书里无聊的部分。 If you are having trouble with one of the questions on the test, skip it and come back to it later. 如果你在考试中遇到某个问题感到困难，可以先跳过它，稍后再回来解答。 She will skip a grade and go right from the fourth to the sixth grade next September. 她将在下个九月跳级，直接从四年级升到六年级。 You can skip over the introduction if you want.
I don't like this song. Let's skip to the next one. 如果你愿意，可以跳过介绍部分。
我不喜欢这首歌，我们跳到下一首吧。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k 7c4cc8bf-7a01-477a-9877-717be871533c b214067d-6f81-4500-a50b-bd8c1b3bb2fc skip verb ˈskɪp https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/s/skip0001.wav to change quickly from one subject, place, etc., to another 迅速从一个主题、地点等切换到另一个 It's hard to understand him when he skips from topic to topic like that. 当他像那样从一个话题跳到另一个话题时，很难理解他。 The movie skips around in time. 这部电影的时间线跳跃不定。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k 16a7850d-13c0-4d84-af29-fe95013782f9 b214067d-6f81-4500-a50b-bd8c1b3bb2fc skip verb ˈskɪp https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/s/skip0001.wav + obj, informal to leave (a place) in a sudden and unexpected way especially to avoid trouble, punishment, etc. （尤指为避免麻烦、惩罚等）突然且出人意料地离开（某地）。 Police are afraid he might try to skip the country. 警方担心他可能会试图逃离该国。 They skipped town while awaiting trial. 他们在等待审判期间逃离了这座城市。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k 3b8dd176-4bf4-4d32-a935-6c94dbbabea3 b214067d-6f81-4500-a50b-bd8c1b3bb2fc skip verb ˈskɪp https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/s/skip0001.wav US to throw (a flat stone) along the surface of water so that it bounces 将（一块扁平的石头）沿着水面掷出，使其弹跳 She's really good at skipping [=(Brit) skimming] stones. 她非常擅长打水漂（英国英语中称为skimming stones）。 I got the rock to skip six times! 我让石头跳了六次水！ eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::rare eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

[=(US) skipping rope, jumping rope] 孩子们正在外面跳绳。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::extend eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k c961b9a5-6c57-437b-bde8-891e80340604 351ddf6a-db90-47a0-b2be-6a9d89f267e9 ambassador noun æmˈbæsədɚ https://media.merriam-webster.com/soundc11/a/ambass01.wav count [often + to] [often used figuratively]
the highest-ranking person who represents his or her own government while living in another country 在另一个国家居住时代表自己政府的最高级别人员 Embassy officials met with the ambassador. 大使馆官员会见了大使。 She became the American ambassador to Italy [=she began representing America in Italy] several years ago. 她几年前成为了美国驻意大利大使。 a baseball player who has been a very effective ambassador [=representative] for his sport 一位一直是其运动非常有效的大使（即代表）的棒球运动员 an ambassador of hope [=a person who tries to bring hope to another country or group of people]
a goodwill ambassador [=a person who travels to different places to promote friendship and goodwill] 希望大使
亲善大使 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23

a real or imaginary machine that is controlled by a computer and is often made to look like a human or animal 一种由计算机控制的真实或虚构的机器，通常被制造得像人类或动物 a talking toy robot 会说话的玩具机器人 science fiction robots 科幻小说中的机器人 a robot dog 一只机器狗 He answered the questions like a robot. 他像机器人一样回答了这些问题。 eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::05k eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::core eggrolls-FREQ60K-MWLD-v1::v26.03.23
